title: Marguerite and the Atlas
author: Isandro Fairweather
blurb: Paloma Thackeray, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
